notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. The NHLR page gives name, route, county, coordinates, elevation, registration date, nominator and a photo credit, but no build date, type, agency, owner or condition text. The 76 ft figure is the page's elevation, not tower height, so height_m is omitted. The brief marks status 'standing' and kind 'unknown'; the page does not state condition, so status is left out of facts and the story does not claim it is standing. Two WebSearch calls and reads of the NHLR SC list, the FFLA SC list (no matches), and the Pineville SC Picture Project page (a different tower) found nothing more. The Post and Courier article on SC towers does not mention Vert. Next steps for an editor: ask the nominator Dan Curry about the tower (photo license unknown, so no photo was added), or check whether the Forest Fire Lookout Association profile fills in later. Access unknown.
